description: This Python source file implements service functions for managing class bookings in a gym management system. It provides functionalities to create bookings, cancel bookings, and retrieve bookings for users, interacting with the database models for bookings and class sessions.

methods.name: Booking create_class_booking(db: Session, user_id: int, class_session_id: int)

methods.name: Booking cancel_class_booking(db: Session, user_id: int, booking_id: int, is_admin: bool = False)
methods.description: Cancels an existing booking if the user owns it or has admin privileges, updating the session spots.

methods.name: get_trainer_bookings_for_user(db: Session, user_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves trainer bookings associated with a user, returning a simplified list of booking details.

methods.name: get_class_bookings_for_user(db: Session, user_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves class bookings for a user, providing details like start/end times and class titles.
